description: This PHP class provides configuration providers for AWS SDK, specifically for use with the 'UseDualstackEndpoint' feature. It includes functions to create default, environment-based, INI-file-based, and fallback configurations, using promises for asynchronous operations.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: Provides various configuration sources for AWS endpoint use, including environment variables, INI files, and defaults, with support for caching and composition.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider that checks environment variables, shared config files, and fallback options, with optional caching.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider based on environment variables.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider based on a specified INI configuration file.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Creates a fallback configuration with default options when other sources are unavailable.
